##### Project general facts

Equiti Residence is a mid-rise residential building offering one, two, and three-bedroom apartments along with multiple fitness and urban lifestyle amenities designed for modern living. This thoughtfully designed development provides spacious apartments with kitchens and large living rooms attached to dining areas, creating a seamless flow for everyday living. Some residences feature two balconies, one attached to the living area and the other to the bedrooms, offering beautiful community views that enhance the living experience.

Residents can enjoy urban lifestyle amenities including a swimming pool, while dedicated parking spaces ensure convenience for all residents. The security system includes a professional security team and comprehensive surveillance cameras monitoring all common-use areas around the clock. A dedicated maintenance team offers regular services, ensuring a hassle-free and secure living environment for all residents.

Each residence features high-quality materials and fully fitted kitchens, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The thoughtfully designed interiors maximize comfort and style, while every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious and inviting home environment. The spacious layouts and modern finishes ensure a truly elevated living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Al Furjan, a residential community in the southern part of Dubai near the Jebel Ali Free Zone and the Dubai Expo site. The community is conveniently located near major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The area offers a variety of housing options including apartments, townhouses, and villas, catering to diverse lifestyle needs.

The community is designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle with a range of amenities and facilities such as parks, community centers, swimming pools, and sports courts. One of the unique features of the area is its emphasis on green spaces, with parks and landscaped areas spread throughout the community. Residents can enjoy a tranquil environment that promotes well-being and outdoor recreation.

The neighborhood offers convenient access to retail outlets and restaurants located within the community, providing residents with easy access to shopping and dining options. The well-planned infrastructure ensures that everything needed for daily life is close at hand. This distinguished location represents the perfect balance of modern convenience, green living, and community connectivity, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most desirable residential communities.
